name: Third Silence
designation_status: Provisional Union translation of a Shadow Fleet term; true name unknown.
canon_observations: Carried by a Shadow Fleet boarding squad inside the concealed vessel.
Marked by a divided-circle symbol with three points.
Altered or interrupted active material behavior in nearby hull, armor, and bodies.
Could suppress visible propagation of the black material when applied to an affected body or suit.
Produced effects compatible with the improvised alternating fields generated by Ranger Span drones and Sentinel shield systems.
Was described by Shadow personnel as one of three commands or Silences.
Was being transported toward the vessel's central region during the Dark Star incident.
staging_hypotheses: The artifact is one of three complete locks required to contain the dark star.
The artifact's function is to separate a distributed consciousness or memory system.
The Shadow Fleet created the artifact.
The Kallis Foundry data core is a replacement or copy of another Silence.
Returning the artifact will safely restore containment.
symbol_boundary: The divided-circle and three-point motif is an observed family of symbols. Variations in line orientation may indicate distinct commands, but that interpretation remains STAGING.
